answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 32921 Country: India Title: Performing Umrah with Mehram/husband. Question: It is known that for female to go for Haj/Umrah her Mehram/husband should be with her. But what is the saying after reaching Makkah. Can the wife go alone to perform umrah/tawaf while husband is taking rest in his hotel room / sitting around in Haram. Answer ID: 32921 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1071/902/B=1432) It is unlawful for a woman to go for hajj and umrah without a mahram male. After reaching Makkah she can do tawaf and umrah without a mahram. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
